role: Technical white paper (v1.4, source revision 6b195c6, scoring version v3.3.nov2026) specifying the overnight recovery measurement: source assembly, sleep-anchored window search, score-ranked window selection, anti-ratchet baseline, frozen versioned recovery score, RR-only sleep staging, vitals sub-score, with prior-art comparison, novelty statements and provenance.
toplevel: Markdown only. Appendix C source map lists 40 repository paths; every one exists at d2c8ca9. Constants in Appendix A were checked against WindowSelection+Scoring.swift, ArtifactDetection.swift, BaselineTracker.swift, Constants+SleepAndDisplay.swift, Constants+RecoveryScore.swift, Constants.swift (ScoringWeights), RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift (scoringParametersV2 bands) and SleepRefreshPolicy.swift and match.

units.does: no behavioural claim: title block: version v1.4 (22 November 2026), author, source revision 6b195c6 (2026-11-21), scoring version v3.3.nov2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current, ScoringVersion.swift), citation line.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > Executive Summary
units.does: Summarizes the method: strap internal recording preferred, with stream beats added only in its gaps and before or after the span it recorded, de-duplicated within 50 ms; undated strap file dated from RR sleep onset vs HealthKit sleep start; window search in 30-70% of measured sleep mapped onto the beat timeline; windows ranked by the Tier-1 HRV sub-score less the ANS term; structural anti-ratchet baseline admission with one slot per wake-date night, a re-analysed session replacing its own reading, each night scored only against earlier nights; frozen scores stamped with a scoring version ('unversioned' when absent); RR-only sleep staging with conservative Watch augmentation. Each claim matches the cited code (DataSourceSelector.createComposite/uncoveredBeats, SleepBoundaryResolver, WindowSelector, BaselineTracker.merge/mergeIntoNight, ScoringVersion, HRVSleepStageClassifier).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 2. Architecture Overview
units.does: Describes the processing phases A-M: capture with 60 s JSONL backup, source selection adding stream beats only where the internal recording has none (gaps, before, after), segment merge, whole-series artifact flags, sleep boundary cascade (HealthKit -> RR HR -> Watch HR -> recording bounds), band mapping, window scan, selection, analysis, tiered scoring, freeze, baseline update, bounded later rescoring; states that time-domain statistics use no interpolated beats, spectral features resample each break-free run of kept beats so no Welch segment spans a recording break (FrequencyDomainAnalyzer.cleanRuns/computeFromCleanRuns/pooledWelchPSD), and DFA interpolates removed beats inside break-free stretches (DFAAnalyzer.compute(window:)). Each phase maps to the listed code paths.

units.does: no behavioural claim: notation: RRPoint fields, endMs = t_ms + rr_ms, valid RR 300-2000 ms (matches HRVConstants.RRInterval used by WindowSelection+Evaluation.swift).

units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for capture and source selection.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.1 Parallel capture and backup
units.does: Claims streamed beats are appended to a JSONL file (header then one object per beat, only beats beyond the stored count), flushed at least every 60 s and forced on reconnect/lifecycle, with a file protection class writable while locked, and failed appends keep beats buffered. Code: RawRRBackup.appendBackup/startAppendFormat/writeAppendData write with .completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication (RawRRBackup+Streaming.swift); overnight backup tick in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.runOvernightIncrementalBackup.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.2 Strap rescue before clear
units.does: Claims the strap start sequence is fixed as [rescueExisting, clearExisting, beginRecording], rescue downloads a stored recording the ledger does not hold, failure aborts instead of clearing, and a test asserts rescue precedes clear for every strap type. Code: StrapStartSequence.Step cases at StrapStartSequence.swift, rescuesBeforeClearing; tests EmuquTests/StrapStartSequenceTests.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.3 Source selection
units.does: Specifies source selection: valid = >=120 beats; internal preferred unless internal is shorter by >5%; then gaps where next.t_ms - prev.endMs > prev.rr + 2000; selects streamed beats whose wallClockMs ?? t_ms lies in a gap or outside the internal span (a strap file, summed from intervals, has no gaps of its own); two-pointer merge with cluster-aware 50 ms de-dup both directions, streamed t_ms rebased to wallClockMs; with no streamed beat selected the composite fails and streaming is used. Code matches DataSourceSelector.swift (selectBestSource, compareDataSources, createComposite, uncoveredBeats, mergePoints).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.1 Capture and source selection > 3.1.4 Dating an undated strap recording
units.does: Specifies dating an undated strap recording: HealthKit sleep for the 24 h ending now with the beats; start = T_hk - onset (onset 0 if none); else now - duration. Onset detector: >300 beats, 120-beat windows in 30-beat steps with >half valid RR, >15 windows, ceiling = midpoint of night's HR range, first j in 5..count-11 with before(5)-after(10) > 8 bpm and after < ceiling, accepted only within 20 min (a later first drop is a misfire: no onset, so onsetMs 0). Code: DeviceRecordingSession.healthKitAlignedStart/recordingStart (RRCollector+DeviceRecording.swift), SleepBoundaryResolver.detectSleepOnset/onsetHRWindows/windowMeanHR/firstSustainedDrop (SleepBoundaryResolver.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.2 Pause/resume concatenation
units.does: Specifies pause/resume concatenation: offset = child.start - parent.start, refused if <=0 or unrepresentable (child analyzed alone), child t_ms and wallClockMs shifted, parent beats then shifted child beats, chains accumulate, pause becomes a recording break. Code: OvernightStreamingCoordinator.childPointsOffsetToParent guards offsetMs > 0 (RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift), mergeParentSessionData/mergedBaseSession.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling
units.does: Section heading: artifact handling drops beats and no time-domain statistic uses an interpolated beat; the one exception is the window's DFA alpha1, which interpolates removed beats inside each break-free stretch (DFAAnalyzer.interpolatedSegments via compute(window:), called from WindowSelector.cleanBeats/evaluateWindow).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.1 Whole-series classifier
units.does: Specifies the whole-series classifier: centered median of up to 51 RR (+-25), flags in order technical (<300 or >2000), extra (<0.5m), ectopic (0.5-0.7m), missed (>1.5m), ectopic (1.2-1.5m), ectopic (|r-m|/m > 0.20), else clean. Code: ArtifactDetector.referenceMedians (rolling median, halfWindow 25) and classify(rrMs:median:): technical out of range, extra below (1-0.5)m, missed above (1+0.5)m, else ectopic beyond 20% of m, which yields exactly this table.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.2 Per-window local ectopic gate
units.does: Specifies the per-window local gate: keep a valid unflagged RR if |r-med|/med <= 0.20 where med is the median of up to 10 neighbours excluding the beat; windows with <=10 values keep all; reported metrics apply the same gate. Code: TimeDomainAnalyzer.ectopicKeepMask/isWithinLocalMedian (localMedianWindow 10, ectopicThresholdPercent 0.20), applied in the window by WindowSelector.cleanBeats.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.3 Artifact handling > 3.3.3 Masked RMSSD with recording breaks
units.does: Specifies recording breaks (t gap > rr_prev + 2000, or wall gap > rr_i + rr_prev + 2000) and masked RMSSD over kept, originally adjacent pairs not following a break; 0 in selection, missing in reporting, with a reporting-only fallback to artifact-clean pairs. Code: TimeDomainAnalyzer.isRecordingBreak/beatsAfterRecordingBreak (TimeDomainAnalysis.swift), WindowSelector.maskedRMSSD (WindowSelection+Filters.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for sleep boundaries and search band.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.1 Boundary sources
units.does: Claims morning-path boundaries come from HealthKit sleep fetched with the RR series for cross-checking, else an RR HR estimate (5-min windows >=10 beats, midpoint threshold, onset = first of 3 below if within 20 min of the recording start (wall clock), else the recording start with latency unknown, wake = window after last below), else Watch passive HR (2 points, >=8 bpm range), else recording bounds; negative onset clamped to 0; HealthKit onset kept whenever it has detailed stages; without them HR replaces it, earlier or later, by >15 min; HR only extends wake. Code: MorningProcessingService.pollForSleepData/applySleepEstimates, HRSleepEstimator.computeWindowedHR/detectSleepBoundariesFromHR/hrSleepThreshold, SleepBoundaryResolver.reconciledStart/reconciledEnd.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.2 Wall-clock to beat-timeline mapping
units.does: Specifies wall-clock to beat-timeline mapping: the offset unchanged when the first beat has no wallClockMs; otherwise the t_ms of the first beat whose wallClockMs (ms since the stream started, the offset's clock) is >= the offset, else the last beat's t_ms; sleepStart = max(recordingStart, map) or recordingStart; sleepEnd = min(map(wake), recordingEnd) if later than sleepStart else recordingEnd (first/last beat t_ms). Code: WindowSelector.tMsPosition(forWallElapsed:in:)/resolveSleepBoundaries/sleepEnd(wakeTimeMs:points:after:recordingEndMs:) (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.4 Sleep boundaries and the search band > 3.4.3 Band
units.does: Specifies the band: early/late at 30%/70% of sleep clamped to recording t_ms, index range first t>=early..last t<=late; <120 beats or empty band yields no window. Code: findSearchBand (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift), searchBand minRequiredBeats 120.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for window selection.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.1 Adaptive geometry
units.does: Specifies adaptive geometry: size 400 if B>=400, B/2 if B>=240, else max(60, 0.6B); step max(10, size/10); windows end at bandStart+size stepping to <= bandEnd. Code: computeAdaptiveWindowSize (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift) and scanWindows (WindowSelection+Evaluation.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.2 Per-window evaluation
units.does: Specifies per-window evaluation: artifactRate = flagged/size vs pass limit; >=50 valid RR; clean floor min(300, max(50, 0.75 size)); masked RMSSD; population SDNN and CV over clean beats; meanHR = 5-95% trimmed sensor HR if >=10 values, plain mean if fewer, else 60000/meanRR; DFA alpha1 if >=64 clean beats, over the window split at recording breaks with gate-removed beats linearly interpolated inside each stretch (end-of-stretch removals left out), boxes 4 to min(16, longest stretch/4) by 2^(1/8), no box spanning a break; relativePosition from midpoint. Code: evaluateWindow/cleanBeats (WindowSelection+Evaluation.swift), DFAAnalyzer.compute(window:)/interpolatedSegments/computeFluctuation/logSpacedBoxSizes.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.3 Two-pass artifact cap
units.does: Specifies the two-pass cap: 10% first, 15% only when the strict pass yields zero windows. Code: scanBandWithArtifactFallback with maxArtifactRateStrict 0.10 / maxArtifactRate 0.15 (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.4 Spike filter and organized filter
units.does: Specifies the spike filter (an interior window whose RMSSD is >= 1.5x both neighbours', both > 0, is removed; the first and last windows are never spikes, so the list never empties) and the organized test (>= 60 clean beats, then alpha1 in 0.75-1.0 and CV < 0.08, or CV < 0.08 alone when alpha1 is nil). Code: WindowSelector.filterIsolatedSpikes/isIsolatedSpike/withoutIsolatedSpikes/selectOrganizedWindow, ScoredRecoveryBlock.classification/isOrganizedRecovery (LF/HF alternative dormant: production blocks carry lfHfRatio nil).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.5 Ranking by the scoring function
units.does: Specifies ranking: with a leave-current-out baseline, organized windows ranked by Tier1(rmssd, meanHR, alpha1, base) without ANS term or legacy readiness, ties by RMSSD then later position; without baseline by RMSSD then later position; consolidated = survived spike filter and CV<0.08. Code: buildRecoveryWindow/rankByTier1Score/rankByRMSSD/recoveryWindow (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift) calling RecoveryScoreCalculator.calculateTier1 with readiness nil and no ansBalance.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.5 Window selection > 3.5.6 Fallbacks and peak capacity
units.does: Specifies fallbacks: no organized window -> peak-RMSSD fallback over the same band with the same two-pass scan and spike filter, flagged not organized; nothing -> whole session analyzed; peak capacity over the whole recording with compact geometry (400; N/3 if N>=360; else max(60,0.4N)), 15% cap, spike filter, max RMSSD, shown but not scored. Code: recoveryOrPeakFallback/peakRMSSDFallback/findPeakMetricWindow/findPeakCapacity (WindowSelection+Scoring.swift); HRVAnalysisPipeline.analyzeSelectedWindow analyzes the full session when recoveryWindow is nil.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for the baseline.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.1 Admission (four gates, in order)
units.does: Specifies four admission gates: overnight session; quality not insufficient/preSleep; window (the session when the analysis has none) >= 300000 ms and (organized or session >= 10800 s); SDNN measured, not estimated (result.isEstimated(.sdnn)); the only direction-dependent exclusion comes from quality rule 3 in classifyHRVQuality. Code: BaselineTracker.admitsToBaseline/isStructurallySoundForBaseline/isStructurallySound, HRVSession.isReliableForHRVAggregates, SessionAcceptanceService.classifyHRVQuality.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.2 One slot per night
units.does: Specifies one slot per night keyed by wake date of the sleep schedule. An update first removes the session's own earlier reading (by session id, or start date for a point stored without one), so a re-analysis replaces its reading outright and one admission refuses only removes it (BaselineTracker.merge/isReading). In the slot, a reading of the same session replaces the incumbent (isSameSession); otherwise the order is: morning reading (end between window start and wake+4h) wins; consolidation (+15% / >=90%); organized (>=95%, organized incumbent beats unorganized newcomer); quality gates (artifact > max(1.5x, 2.0) or CV > 1.3x loses); else >5% readiness improvement; missing defaults 0/false/100%; 90 points kept sorted. Code: mergeIntoNight/isSameSession/shouldReplace/newWindowIsObjectivelyBetter and the verdict helpers (BaselineTracker+NightReplacement.swift), BaselineTracker.merge/isReading/commitChanges, SleepSchedule.nightKey/isMorningReading, maxHistoricalPoints 90.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.3 Statistics
units.does: Specifies statistics: last 60 stored nights, >=3 points and >=3 positive RMSSD; lnMean; lnSD = max(sampleSD * w, 0.10) with w = sqrt(7/n) below 7; hrMean, hrSD = max(sampleSD(meanHR) * w_HR, 0.5) with the same widening over the points in the window; CV7 over last 7 (>=3 positive) else none; lastDate. Why: widening keeps early z near 0, and three similar nights cannot turn a 2 bpm rise into the full resting-HR deduction. Code: stats/baselineStats/widenedLnSD/smallSampleWidening/sevenDayCV (BaselineTracker.swift) with lnRmssdSDFloor 0.10 and meanHRSDFloor 0.5.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.6 Baseline > 3.6.4 Leave-current-out
units.does: Specifies leave-current-out: only nights with nightKey strictly earlier than the scored night are used, feeding both ranking and score. Code: recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:sleepSchedule:) (BaselineTracker.swift), used by MorningProcessingService.swift, ReanalysisService.swift, SessionRecoveryService.swift, RRCollector.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026)
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading naming scoring version v3.3.nov2026 (matches ScoringVersion.current).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026) > 3.7.1 z-mapping
units.does: Specifies z = (ln RMSSD - lnMean)/lnSD mapped piecewise-linearly through (-3,5)(-1.5,25)(-0.75,64)(-0.5,72)(0.5,72)(1.5,90), clamped at ends, NaN -> 50. Code: zToRecoveryScore/interpolate with defaultScoringParameters = scoringParametersV2 (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026) > 3.7.2 Tier-1 HRV sub-score
units.does: Specifies Tier-1: map(z) + clamp(-5 * zHR, +-10) + alpha1 term (+5 in 0.75-1.0, -5 >1.2, -3 <0.60) + CV7 term (-5 <2%, -3 >12%) + ANS term (-6 <-1.5, -3 <-0.5, +2 >=1.5) - staleness min(20, 5(1+(d-7)/7)) for d>=7, clamped 0-100. Without a baseline (fewer than 3 nights) a reading with RMSSD > 0 takes the absolute bands 60/45/30/20 -> 85/70/55/40, else 25; a night with no usable RMSSD takes legacy readiness*10 when present, else 50. Code: calculateTier1/baselineNormalisedScore/rhrAdjustment/dfaAlpha1Adjustment/cvAdjustment/ansBalanceAdjustment/baselineStalenessPenalty/absoluteRMSSDScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator+Tiers.swift) with constants in Constants+RecoveryScore.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026) > 3.7.3 Tiers
units.does: Specifies tiers: Tier 3 (sleep+vitals) 0.60/0.25/0.15, comeback 0.80/0.20/0.00 for 21 days from the set date; Tier 2 0.70/0.30 dampened to 0.85/0.15 when z<-1 and Sleep<50; Tier 1 = T1 (vitals unused). Code: ScoreDetailBuilder.buildTierComposite/buildTier3/tier3Weights/buildTier2/buildTier1, ScoringWeights (Constants.swift), UserSettings.isComebackModeActive (UserSettings+Model.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026) > 3.7.4 Final composite
units.does: Specifies the tail: Tier-1 missing-sleep penalty 10 when sleep integration and the opt-in are on and sleep is nil; clamp 0-100; SpO2 <95% subtracts 10 floored at 0; every deduction listed. Code: missingSleepPenaltyApplies/composeFinalScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift), VitalsScoring.applyVitalsOverrides/vitalsPenaltyDescriptions.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.7 Recovery score (v3.3.nov2026) > 3.7.5 Training load is excluded
units.does: Claims training-load metrics are not recovery-score inputs and a separate training readiness is frozen alongside. Code: calculateWithBreakdown discards trainingMetrics/trainingContext (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift); SessionAcceptanceService.applyFrozenScore sets frozenReadiness via ReanalysisService.computeFrozenReadiness.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for score freezing.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.1 Snapshot
units.does: Specifies the snapshot: sleep for the whole overnight window plus vitals fetched with a 10 s timeout (score without them on timeout); vitals resting HR replaced by the strap window mean HR. Code: snapshotHealthData/fetchSleepAndVitals/sleepFetchRange (SessionAcceptanceService.swift), RecoveryVitals.withStrapNocturnalRHR.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.2 Inputs
units.does: Specifies inputs: window RMSSD/meanHR/alpha1, ANS = PNS - SNS, leave-current-out baseline, reference date = session end. Code: SessionAcceptanceService.scoreBreakdown (SessionAcceptanceService.swift) passes referenceDate session.endDate ?? startDate.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.3 Quality decision
units.does: Specifies the quality decision: (1) short window or (unorganized and <3 h) with RMSSD < exp(lnMean) -> insufficient; (2) sleep exists and recording does not overlap it -> preSleep; (3) RMSSD < base and <3 h -> insufficient; else good. Code: classifyHRVQuality/insufficientDataDecision/overlapsSleep (SessionAcceptanceService.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.4 Unusable-reading blend
units.does: Specifies the unusable-reading blend: score with RMSSD = exp(lnMean), meanHR = hrMean, no alpha1, no readiness; with a perceived-readiness answer HRV factor = 0.70 T1 + 0.30*100p (p clamped), recomposed through the missing-sleep and SpO2 tail. Code: FiniteHRVInputs.substitutingBaseline, blendingPerceivedReadiness/blendedFactors/subjectiveScore/composeFinalScore (RecoveryScoreCalculator.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.5 What is stored
units.does: Specifies storage: recoveryScore = composite/10, scoreBreakdown with scoringVersion 'v3.3.nov2026', frozen training readiness; breakdowns decoded without a version are labelled 'unversioned'. Code: applyFrozenScore/toTenScale, ScoreBreakdown init(from:) defaulting to ScoringVersion.unversioned, ScoringVersion.current.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.8 Score freezing > 3.8.6 Mutation rules
units.does: Specifies mutation rules: bulk reanalysis skips manual windows; auto sleep refresh never overwrites a user-edited snapshot but may fill a missing one without rescoring; pulled sessions fill-only; imported duplicates adopt a score only when none exists; auto upgrade only for the most recent scored overnight ending within 18 h, serialized, plausibility-checked, update on first snapshot / end later >60 s / more minutes / onset move >=15 / source upgrade, rescore on first / >=20 min / onset >=15 / upgrade, scoring boundaries moved with the snapshot; cross-device the newer whole-second modifiedAt copy wins, of two in the same second the server's copy, and a device stamps an edit no earlier than one second after the latest stamp it has seen on an iCloud copy. Code: ReanalysisService bulk skip, SleepRefreshPolicy.*, SessionReanalysisCoordinator.loadTodaysOvernightSession/performAutoRefreshTodaysSleepIfImproved/freshPlausibleSleep, SessionMerger.singleSeriesOutcome, CloudKitSessionFreshness.decide/wholeSeconds/onTie/stamp(at:after:)/noteSeen.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging
units.does: no behavioural claim: section heading for RR-only sleep staging.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.1 Epochs and features
units.does: Specifies epochs: 5-min epochs between sleep start/end, >=10 beats and >=8 valid RR, >=6 epochs; per-epoch HR, population SDNN and CV over valid beats; RMSSD only between valid beats adjacent in the recording (none across a dropped beat or a recording break, pause > one RR + 2 s); alpha1 and LF/HF/HF on the longest break-free stretch, alpha1 with dropped beats interpolated and ends trimmed, >= 64 beats and <= 6 % interpolated. Code: HRVSleepStageClassifier.classify/buildFeatureWindows/featureWindow/windowVariability/windowAlpha1/windowFrequencyMetrics and SleepWindowBeats (windowSizeMs 5 min).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.2 Within-night rank normalization
units.does: Specifies within-night fractional ranks with mean rank for ties; missing fills alpha1 -> night median or 0.85, LF/HF -> 2.0, HF -> 0. Code: computeFeatureRanks/computeRanks/tieGroupEnd (HRVSleepStageClassifier.swift), fallbackMedianDFA 0.85.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.3 Scores
units.does: Specifies deep/REM/awake scores with temporal priors and the four availability-dependent weight sets of Table 3.4, REM forced to 0 in the first 60 min. Code: computeWindowScores/windowScores/computeDeepScore/deepTemporalBonus/computeREMScore/remTemporalBonus/computeAwakeScore with weights in Constants+SleepAndDisplay.swift (all values match the table) and minTimeBeforeREMMs 60 min (HRVSleepStageClassifier.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.4 Decision and smoothing
units.does: Specifies decision thresholds awake >0.80, deep >0.60 and >=rem, REM >0.63 and >deep, else core; single-epoch smoothing that never removes awake. Code: classifyStage/classifyWindows (HRVSleepStageClassifier.swift), smoothStages (HRVSleepStageClassifier+Watch.swift), thresholds Constants+SleepAndDisplay.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.5 Intervals
units.does: Specifies intervals of consecutive same-stage epochs, ended also by a dropped epoch. Code: buildIntervals (HRVSleepStageClassifier+Watch.swift).

units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.9 RR-only sleep staging > 3.9.6 Watch augmentation
units.does: Specifies Watch augmentation: Watch stages anchor; each RR epoch takes the Watch stage covering most of it, an uncovered epoch is left alone; overrides core->deep (deep>0.68, >rem), core->REM (epoch's own LF/HF, rem>0.63, >deep), awake->REM (own LF/HF, rem>0.68, awake<0.80), deep->REM (own LF/HF, rem>0.72, deep<0.40), REM->deep (deep>0.72 and the REM score before the first-hour lockout < 0.40); only the overridden part is repainted. units.key: § Emuqu — Overnight Recovery Measurement from Raw Beat Intervals > 3. Methods > 3.10 Vitals sub-score
